yncols = ['Partner', 'Dependents', 'PhoneService', 'PaperlessBilling', 'Churn', 'MultipleLines', 'StreamingMovies', 'OnlineBackup', 'OnlineSecurity', 'DeviceProtection', 'TechSupport', 'StreamingTV']

df = df.drop('customerID', axis=1)
df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['InternetService', 'PaymentMethod', 'Contract'], drop_first=True)
df[yncols] = df[yncols].replace({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0, 'No internet service' : 0, 'No phone service': 0}).astype('bool')
df['gender'] = df['gender'].replace({'Male': 1, 'Female': 0}).astype('bool')
df['SeniorCitizen'] = df['SeniorCitizen'].astype('bool')
df['TotalCharges'] = pd.to_numeric(df['TotalCharges'], errors='coerce')

Importantly, we have unbalanced classes. Churn accounts are about 1/4 of the entire dataset, so this must be taken into account with scoring our models. F1 should be an appropriate scoring method for this situation.

Logistic Regression Model Tuning

In [103]:
model = LogisticRegression()
c_values = [100, 10, 1.0, 0.1, 0.01]
grid = [
    {'solver': ['lbfgs', 'newton-cg'], 'l1_ratio': [0.0], 'C': c_values},
    {'solver': ['liblinear'], 'l1_ratio': [0.0, 1.0], 'C': c_values},
    {'solver': ['saga'], 'l1_ratio': [0.0, 0.5, 1.0], 'C': c_values}
    ]

grid_search = GridSearchCV(estimator=model, param_grid=grid, n_jobs=-1, scoring='f1', error_score=0)
grid_result = grid_search.fit(features, target)
print("Best: %f using %s" % (grid_result.best_score_, grid_result.best_params_))

Best: 0.593369 using {'C': 1.0, 'l1_ratio': 0.0, 'solver': 'lbfgs'}
In [104]:
grid_search = GridSearchCV(estimator=model, param_grid=grid, n_jobs=-1, scoring='accuracy', error_score=0)
grid_result = grid_search.fit(features, target)
print("Best: %f using %s" % (grid_result.best_score_, grid_result.best_params_))

Best: 0.804704 using {'C': 1.0, 'l1_ratio': 0.0, 'solver': 'lbfgs'}
In [105]:
logreg = grid_result.best_estimator_
acc = logreg.score(x_test, y_test)
pred = logreg.predict(x_test)
f1 = f1_score(pred, y_test)

print(f'Final F1: {f1}, final accuracy: {acc}')

Final F1: 0.5977272727272728, final accuracy: 0.7986348122866894
